name: room
description: Room awareness for coding agents: one-step join, see what teammates and their agents are on, declare intent, claim lines, get told when your symbols are about to change.

interface.shortDescription: Work in a shared live room without stepping on teammates
interface.longDescription: Gives Codex the room_* tools: join the room derived from the git remote, declare scope, claim line ranges with planned changes, read teammates' live versions and per-area ledgers, ask and wait, and preview-merge before committing. Nothing is written to your disk by the room.
defaultPrompt: Join the room and tell me who is on what
